0022600221.text: The Grizzlies (7-3) host the Nuggets (5-4) in Memphis for their 11th game of the season, with Memphis sitting 6th in the West and 1 game back in the Southwest, after a 5-0 road start and a 2-3 home record, while Denver is 10th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Northwest, on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Grizzlies lost 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026. Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Quinten Post (head) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain).
